biomesize.slider.biome_size.info: Size of land biomes like forest, plains and desert. 100% is vanilla.
biomesize.slider.terrain_scale.info: Size of continents, oceans and mountain ranges. 100% is vanilla. Low values make steep, narrow mountains.
biomesize.slider.dramatic.info: How tall and jagged mountain peaks and cliffs get. 100% is vanilla, 0% takes the jagged peaks away.
biomesize.slider.cave_size.info: Ratio of big caves to small tunnels. Above 100% gives more and bigger caverns and thinner tunnels, below 100% fewer caverns and wider tunnels.
biomesize.slider.mountains.info: How much of the world is tall mountains. 100% is vanilla, 0% is mostly flat, above 200% is mountain country.
biomesize.button.info: Biome size, terrain, mountains, caves and underground water and lava. Saved with the new world.
biomesize.screen.title: World Shape
biomesize.slider.water.info: How many underground water pools and single-block water springs (waterfalls in cave walls) there are. 100% is vanilla, 0% is almost none. Overworld only.
biomesize.slider.lava.info: How many deep lava pools and single-block lava springs (lavafalls in cave walls) there are. 100% is vanilla, 0% is none. Overworld only.
